CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with input as (select private.dic_roaster_key(value) as key)
 select coalesce(
   (select a.canonical_key from private.dic_roaster_name_aliases a
      join input i on i.key=a.alias_key limit 1),
   (select key from input)
 );
$function$
full_current_definitions.verdict: Canonicalizes roaster through live private.dic_roaster_name_aliases table, falling back to normalized name. It is LEGACY ACTIVE provenance, distinct from retired curated directory. No direct anon/authenticated EXECUTE.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_coffee_key(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select nullif(regexp_replace(lower(extensions.unaccent(coalesce(value,''))), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'),'');
$function$
full_current_definitions.verdict: Lowercases and unaccents coffee name, removes non-alphanumeric characters and treats empty as null; suitable as matching candidate key only, not unique identity proof. No direct anon/authenticated EXECUTE.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_verified_roaster_page_proof(roaster_name text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare host_count integer; official_host text; canonical_name text;
begin
 with official_pages as (
  select distinct c.roaster as source_roaster,
   lower(regexp_replace(split_part(s.source_url,'/',3),'^www\.','','i')) as source_host
  from public.coffees c join public.coffee_sources s on s.coffee_id=c.id
  where c.verification_state='verified' and c.merged_into_id is null
   and s.source_kind='roaster_page' and s.checked_at>=now()-interval '120 days'
   and s.source_url ~* '^https://(www\.)?[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+(/|$)'
   and private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(c.roaster)=private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(roaster_name)
 )
 select count(distinct source_host),min(source_host),min(source_roaster)
 into host_count,official_host,canonical_name from official_pages;
 -- Conflicting verified product source domains must be reviewed, not guessed.
 if host_count>1 then return null; end if;
 if host_count=1 and official_host is not null then
  if exists(select 1 from private.dic_official_source_attestations a
    where a.canonical_key=private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(roaster_name)
      and a.official_domain<>official_host) then return null; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('official_domain',official_host,'canonical_name',canonical_name);
 end if;
 -- Preserve prior independently verified official BRAND evidence for the
 -- original source worker bootstrap. This NEVER gates a URL preview.
 select a.canonical_name,a.official_domain into canonical_name,official_host
 from private.dic_official_source_attestations a
 where a.canonical_key=private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(roaster_name);
 if official_host is null then return null; end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('official_domain',official_host,'canonical_name',canonical_name);
end $function$
full_current_definitions.verdict: Uses recent uniquely identified verified roaster-page host and rejects conflicting domains or attestation conflict, with older independent domain attestation fallback; fallback is for worker and expressly not a universal URL admission gate. Historical source trust still requires exact identity acceptance.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_url_preview_claim(account_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role',true) is distinct from 'service_role' then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Trusted preview worker only.';
 end if;
 return private.dic_shared_preview_claim(account_id);
end $function$
full_current_definitions.verdict: Service-role-only older preview claim wrapper invokes live shared account budget, not a retired public roaster allowlist. Uses request.jwt.claim.role service gate plus effective service-only EXECUTE; do not remove without consumer/API dependency proof.
